name: Akara (fried bean-paste balls)
notes: ESTIMATED WEIGHTS (team judgement, not measured). Rationale: the batter is whipped, so foaming matters; it must hold water to stay soft; lower flour oil absorption is a proxy for a less greasy fry. Flour oil-absorption is not the same as frying oil uptake. Confirm with a mentor.

name: Steamed bean pudding (moin-moin, ekuru, okpa)
notes: ESTIMATED WEIGHTS (team judgement). Rationale: a steamed pudding must hold water and set (a lower least gelation concentration means it gels more easily), and bind oil and pepper. Confirm with a mentor.

name: Bean soup / thick stew base (gbegiri)
notes: ESTIMATED WEIGHTS (team judgement). Rationale: thickens by holding water and keeps oil mixed in. Confirm with a mentor.

name: Seed-based soup (egusi, groundnut soup)
notes: ESTIMATED WEIGHTS (team judgement). Rationale: ground seed that holds oil and water gives body. Confirm with a mentor.
